name: Knight of Xoroth: the Greater Imp keeps its lesser Pestilence after a relog (#4286)
contract: Pestilence of Apocalypse 804786 marks the caster with a permanent self aura and, while Impish Pestilence 300398 is active, applies the matching lesser Pestilence 806962 onto the already-summoned Greater Imp 510100. That pet aura must survive a relog exactly like the player's own Pestilence stance does, so the imp does not come back without its buff.
